Try it: click any chip to swap the week below it. The dark Today button appears once you have wandered off this week. The gear on a row opens the Rhythm drawer; New opens the two-act create choice.

Nov 26 on Thursday Bible Study is cancelled — open it to see how a week that didn't happen reads.
Evidence for the standalone bug issue. This is the same three Rhythms and the same term as the redesign beside it, rendered the way the shipped code actually renders production data.
